set.body: Scope: revised PRD Phase 5. Add namespaced major-versioned representation keys, a narrow archive-neutral representation envelope, an immutable duplicate-rejecting registry, unsupported-representation errors, a named LegacyLnaRepresentationFamily, and ScalafimRuntime.openResponse. Acceptance: registry construction is deterministic and order-independent; tests install one family; manifests select only installed code; unknown representation differs from corruption; legacy LNA fixtures still open; openResponse performs driver selection, structural/publication validation, family lookup, binding, and source construction in the documented order; resources close on success, failure, and cancellation; the frozen numerical corpus remains green.
